next_steps.action: Measure the LDO's VIN pin voltage.

measure.where: LDO VIN pin (consult datasheet for pin number)
measure.expected: Per LDO datasheet — e.g. +3VALW (3.3 V) or +5VALW (5 V) or coin cell (3.0 V).
measure.safety: Probe carefully to avoid shorting adjacent pins.

interpretations.if_result: VIN present and at expected voltage
interpretations.then: Input supply is good. Proceed to check EN.
Upstream rail is dead. For VCCRTC also check the coin cell (~3.0 V) and the diode-OR that selects between coin cell and +3VALW. Diagnose upstream rail first.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need LDO datasheet for VIN pin number and expected voltage.
